notes: system commands in the message box: /compact (moved out of the ⋯ menu) and /copy - /copy puts the last reply on the clipboard as markdown, /copy all the whole chat (the same text as Export), /copy code the last fenced code block; commands run in the browser, never reach the model and never become a message, and typing the space after /copy turns the / menu into its options, each completing the whole line; the app no longer ships the seven example skills, so Settings > Skills starts empty and a skill can no longer be named after a command (skills you already have are untouched)
